consentListResponse.description: List of consent states for the authenticated user

consentState.description: Represents the current state of a consent for a specific user

name.description: The unique name/identifier of the consent

identifier.description: The user identifier (typically the user ID) for whom this consent state applies

status.description: The current state of the consent. 'requested' means the user has not yet responded, 'accepted' means the user granted consent, 'revoked' means the user withdrew consent
